request: Inventory.total_value() reports the wrong number: it sums each item's unit_price but ignores the quantity on hand, so ten widgets at $2.50 are valued at $2.50 instead of $25.00. Total value should be the sum of quantity * unit_price across all items. Fix total_value and add a regression test covering it. Do not break the existing tests in tests/test_inventory.py.
